entities.summary: Ch'oe Cheu, art name Suun, was a Korean religious leader. He was the founder of Donghak, a religious movement which was empathetic to the hardships of the minjung, opposed Catholicism and its association with Western imperialism, and offered an alternative to orthodox Neo-Confucianism.
